usage: bike-settle [-h] [--physics-config PATH] [--physics {legacy,physical}]
                   [--track TRACK] [--seed SEED] [--length M]
                   [--rider {none,lumped,seated,articulated_planar}]
                   [--rider-mass KG] [--rider-height M] [--rider-inseam M]
                   [--no-rider] [--speed KMH]
                   [--drive {coast,ideal_speed_control,crank_effort,articulated_effort}]
                   [--timestep S] [--initial-speed KMH] [--human-torque NM]
                   [--assist-gain ASSIST_GAIN]
                   [--assist {off,eco,tour,sport,turbo,emtb}]
                   [--crank-phase DEG] [--max-steps MAX_STEPS]
                   [--tolerance TOLERANCE] --out PATH

Settle a physical-mode scenario into its validated initial equilibrium and
write the pose to --out. Runs whose physics config sets equilibrium_state_file
to the written file start from that pose instead of re-settling.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --physics-config PATH
                        physical-mode TOML profile; overrides below win over
                        its values
  --physics {legacy,physical}
                        'physical' selects the physical model without a TOML
  --track TRACK         preset name or path to a .toml track file (default:
                        road_worn); presets: alpine_rocky, alpine_scree,
                        climb_steps, enduro_aggressive, flat, road_broken,
                        road_smooth, road_worn, single_edge, washboard_only
  --seed SEED           generator seed override for road presets and seeded
                        track files
  --length M            track length override in metres, same applicability as
                        --seed
  --rider {none,lumped,seated,articulated_planar}
                        rider model (default: articulated_planar for
                        articulated_effort, lumped otherwise)
  --rider-mass KG       rider mass including helmet and kit, kg (default 80)
  --rider-height M      rider stature in metres (default 1.80)
  --rider-inseam M      rider inseam in metres (default 0.47 x height)
  --no-rider            settle the bike alone (alias for --rider none)
  --speed KMH           cruise target in km/h; only an ideal_speed_control
                        target
  --drive {coast,ideal_speed_control,crank_effort,articulated_effort}
                        physical drive mode override: coast,
                        ideal_speed_control, crank_effort, articulated_effort
  --timestep S          integration step in seconds
  --initial-speed KMH   initial speed in km/h
  --human-torque NM     rider crank torque for effort drive modes, N m
  --assist-gain ASSIST_GAIN
                        assist gain override
  --assist {off,eco,tour,sport,turbo,emtb}
                        assist mode override
  --crank-phase DEG     crank angle at the start of the run, degrees
  --max-steps MAX_STEPS
                        settle budget in integration steps (default 400000)
  --tolerance TOLERANCE
                        convergence tolerance on max |qacc| (default .05)
  --out PATH            the pose file to write (.npz)

The pose file embeds the fingerprint of the resolved configuration; a run
loads it only when track, rider, physics config and compiled model all match.
bike-settle never runs the ride itself.
